title: Tagalog Academy
description: A guided path to practical Tagalog.
outcome: Understand and use practical Tagalog for introductions, people, preferences, home life, buying, time, and daily routines.

lessons.title: Greetings and Introductions
lessons.summary: Greet people, introduce yourself, and talk about how you feel.

lessons.title: People and Family
lessons.summary: Name family relationships and describe people clearly.

lessons.title: Colors and Preferences
lessons.summary: Name colors and express what you like or dislike.

lessons.title: Food and Drinks
lessons.summary: Name everyday food and drinks and talk about preferences.

lessons.title: Home and Location
lessons.summary: Name household objects and say where people and things are.

lessons.title: Numbers and Quantities
lessons.summary: Count, recognize common tens, and ask how many.

lessons.title: Fruit and the Market
lessons.summary: Name fruit and complete a simple market exchange.

lessons.title: Days and Time
lessons.summary: Talk about days, time, and a simple schedule.

lessons.title: Daily Routine
lessons.summary: Describe completed morning activities in order.
